ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominated by low-intensity pixels (dark pigmentation) with approximately 95% coverage; high-intensity pixels (white) are limited to small localized clusters and highlights at the trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Symmetric dark pigmentation across both lobes; high-contrast white clusters are mapped to the distal tips and along the apex of trailing edge serrations; one diagonal white linear feature is mapped to the inner portion of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an estimated angle of 45 degrees relative to the lobe centerlines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and high-frequency serrations with peak-to-valley amplitudes ranging from 5 to 20 pixels, distributed continuously along the trailing boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge trajectory sweeping upward and outward from the central notch toward the distal tips; distal tips exhibit a convex rounded termination with high surface complexity.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular white spots (barnacle scars/colonies) at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes and sporadically along the trailing edge peaks.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent diagonal white scratch on the lower right lobe; multiple faint vertical and horizontal linear disruptions on the upper left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced barnacle colonization at the distal tips; linear scarring on the right lobe; irregular trailing edge indicative of previous mechanical impact or predation attempts.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely jagged, saw-like profile of the entire trailing edge boundary, creating a unique signature pattern of pointed protrusions.
